title: Does potassium–bicarbonate context improve systolic-pressure prediction? An exploratory cross-wave null result
abstract: In exploratory temporal transport between separately recruited NHANES2009–2010 and2015–2016 adults (n=4,800 and4,435), a serum potassium×bicarbonate product did not establish improved systolic-pressure prediction beyond flexible routine measures: added-minus-baseline weighted MSE=0.219805mmHg², joint survey-PSU bootstrap95% interval[-0.590929,2.212013].
